stylePrompt: Traditional hand-painted animation cel illustration in the style of Studio Ghibli, specifically the painterly warmth of Hayao Miyazaki's films. Characters drawn with soft rounded features, large expressive eyes full of genuine emotion, simple noses and mouths that carry enormous feeling through subtle shifts, hair and cloth moving with natural weight. Rich natural colors, warm golds, deep earthy browns, soft blue dusk sky, weathered Roman stone, bronze armor, dusty amber atmosphere. Backgrounds are lavish hand-painted watercolor and gouache with visible paper texture and individually crafted surfaces. Light is soft and golden, magic-hour warmth, shadows are warm not cold. No harsh lines, no sharp digital edges, no flat cel-shading. The mood is melancholy beauty and quiet historical tragedy.
